overview_description.description:
Conduktor is a proactive unifying layer for any operational data source that accelerates data utilization. It is providing security and control to maximize data streaming utilization in enterprise. Backed mainly by RTP Global, Ansa, M12 (Microsoft’s), Accel, we're pioneering the Streaming Data Management space.

We provide a platform to help central teams defining multi-layered security and governance controls through an independent flexible layer. It's combined to a powerful Console for engineering teams to self-serve, drive efficiency, and reduce inconsistencies. 

Honored to work with such customers as Capital Group, Lufthansa, Honda, DICK'S, and so many other leading enterprises in USA and Europe.

product.name: Conduktor Scale
product.description: A platform to manage and scale data streaming with security controls, monitoring, and governance for Kafka ecosystems.

product.name: Conduktor Shield
product.description: A security solution to protect streaming data with encryption, audit trails, failover, and compliance features for Kafka clusters.

product.name: Conduktor Exchange
product.description: A platform for secure, controlled real-time data sharing between partners with traffic policies and partner management.

product.name: Conduktor Trust
product.description: A data quality enforcement tool that applies rules and policies at the source to ensure reliable streaming data.
